name: r6
note: Values are written in Roblox's own axes (+x is the character's right, -z is forward). The loader converts them to blockreel's axes (x and z flipped: the character faces +z, its right is -x). Only the position part of each joint is used; the 90-degree axis fix-up rotations in the real joints are not needed here.
sources: https://devforum.roblox.com/t/help-with-height-system-r6/2074284  (head is a 2x1x1 part with a Head mesh at scale 1.25, sunk 0.125 into the torso)
https://github.com/matttttt169/Proton-reanimation  (Neck C0/C1, same numbers as the others)
confidence: Part sizes and joint offsets agree across the sources above. No first-party Roblox page lists the R6 joints, so this is cross-checked from community sources, not from Roblox documentation.

stance.note: Torso centre height above the feet when standing: leg height 2 + half the torso height 1.

extensions.note: Not part of the Roblox rig. R6 has no spine, so a torso lean needs its own pivot. The torso rotates about the waist (bottom centre of the torso); the legs stay attached at the hips.
